verdict.rationale: Together AI's quickstart documents official SDKs for Python and TypeScript. The first-party TypeScript library on GitHub gives server-side access to the REST API with SSE streaming, and the docs show SDK use across features such as fine-tuning. Community users also mention the Python API. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference details (e.g., Python SDK repo/docs, versioning or typing guarantees) in the evidence pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Together AI publishes official SDKs for Python and TypeScript
This library provides convenient access to the Together REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
We provide support for streaming responses using Server Sent Events (SSE).
You can launch a fine-tuning job from the console, through the API/SDK, or with the CLI
